{{dablink|For the ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]'' by the same name, see [[Dorindha (Far Dareis Mai)|Dorhindha]].}}
'''Dorindha''' is an [[Aiel]] and is the [[Roofmistress]] of [[Smoke Springs Hold]]. She is married to [[Bael]] and first sisters with [[Melaine]].

== Appearance ==
She is a solid, motherly woman with creases in the corner of her blue eyes and streaks of white in her red hair. 

== Activities ==
She is present during the meeting with Rand, [[Davram Bashere]] and Bael after Rand had been rescued from the [[White Tower]] [[Aes Sedai]] in [[Caemlyn]] and is a very calming influence during the whole exchange.

She comes to summon Aviendha with the news that she is to leave with the rest of the [[Aiel]] from [[Caemlyn]].
